name: @ohos-npm-ports/prisma
description: Prisma is an open-source database toolkit. It includes a JavaScript/TypeScript ORM for Node.js, migrations and a modern GUI to view and edit the data in your database. You can use Prisma in new projects or add it to an existing one. (OpenHarmony repack: on openharmony, Prisma engines resolve from the @prisma/engines package root instead of being downloaded from binaries.prisma.sh, which has no OHOS builds.)
author: Tim Suchanek <suchanek@prisma.io>
